description: Target mode: the request is forwarded to the local server with Host removed, x-forwarded-host = public Host, x-forwarded-proto = https, accept-encoding = identity and the incoming query appended to the target URL. The local server sends no response headers within targetTimeoutMs, so the SDK answers 504 {"error":"local server timed out"}. MCPWARP.md §4
in:
POST /mcp?x=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
accept-encoding: gzip
content-type: application/json
mcp-session-id: abc
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 34

{"error":"local server timed out"}
notes: In target mode `handler` describes the local server. targetTimeoutMs bounds only the wait for response headers; the SDK SHOULD abort the upstream fetch when the runtime has a cancel signal and MAY let it settle otherwise.
